from collections import Counter
def rects(g):
    # find maximal rectangles drawn as closed rectangles of a distinct color c != background
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for c in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg}:
        cells=[(r,col) for r,row in enumerate(g) for col,x in enumerate(row) if x==c]
        if len(cells)<4: continue
        rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[col for _,col in cells]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        perim=[g[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1+1) for c in [c0,c1]]+[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1) for r in [r0,r1]]
        if all(x==c for x in perim) and (r1-r0>=1 and c1-c0>=1):
            out.append((r0,r1,c0,c1))
    return bg,out

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); res=[]
    for r0 in range(H):
        for r1 in range(r0+2,H):

                    if all(g[r][c0]==c and g[r][c1]==c for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and \
